title: Aligning delivery accountability with decision authority

intent.outcome: Allow an accountable delivery team to make routine, reversible decisions without waiting for ad hoc permission.
success_signals: Routine decisions complete within the agreed service window
Exceptions follow a visible escalation route
non_goals: Removing independent review for irreversible changes

actors.role: Defines boundaries and approves high-impact exceptions
Enforces checks and records execution evidence

authority.scope: Changes classified as routine and reversible
conditions: Change remains inside the approved boundary

boundaries.rule: The delivery team cannot change its own approval boundary.
boundaries.enforcement: Protected policy files and independent production promotion

boundaries.rule: Execution stops when required evidence is missing.

trust_signals.signal: Actor is authorized for the requested scope

evidence.signal: Reviewed proposal, checks, approval, deployment, and rollback reference

escalation.trigger: The change exceeds routine scope or a required check fails.
escalation.stop_condition: No execution until an explicit decision is recorded

feedback.signal: Decision delay, failed changes, emergency intervention, and rollback frequency
feedback.response: Adjust decision rights or controls through a reviewed change
